title: RRSC vs a reference R implementation of both regimes (He, Li, Shi & Miao 2026), live
paper: He, P., Li, Y., Shi, X. & Miao, W. (2026). 'A robust regression approach to synthetic control with interference.' arXiv:2411.01249
